# SEC company regression cases

RIVN (CIK 1874178), XOM (34088), JPM (19617) are normalized copies of public SEC company-facts data and submissions metadata retrieved November 1, 2026. Annual figures cover 2021–2025 and retain fact-level accession, dates, exact tags and source links. Microsoft uses the report's existing five-year snapshot (annual base June 30, 2026). These are regression fixtures, not current market quotes or a full financial-statement audit.

Sources: https://data.sec.gov/api/xbrl/companyfacts/CIK0001874178.json ; https://data.sec.gov/api/xbrl/companyfacts/CIK0000034088.json ; https://data.sec.gov/api/xbrl/companyfacts/CIK0000019617.json . SIC classifications come from the matching https://data.sec.gov/submissions/CIK##########.json documents. Refresh by downloading both public files and calling `normalize(facts, ticker, submissions)` from `src/finance.mjs`.

Known coverage gaps remain visible: selected current debt for RIVN; operating income, inventory, depreciation and noncurrent debt for XOM; many industrial tags and supported quarterly revenue periods for JPM. Missing feed tags do not establish absence in the original filings. The tests exercise negative margins, unavailable components, source periods, formula reconciliation, and financial-industry exclusions. The $100 reference prices in tests are calculation fixtures, never market data.

AAPL and AMZN `*-raw.json` fixtures retain only selected standard SEC tags (and eligible period histories), retrieved November 1, 2026, from CIK0000320193 and CIK0001018724 company-facts endpoints. They exercise normalization, not pre-normalized outputs. Amazon's reviewed annual custom-tag property sale/incentive supplements are sourced from its 2025 and 2023 10-K inline XBRL, with exact annual starts/ends and source URLs stored by the normalizer. The broader PaymentsToAcquireProductiveAssets mapping is restricted to Amazon, whose statements label it cash property/equipment purchases; it is not a universal synonym for capex.

NVIDIA `nvda-raw.json` is a selected-tag SEC company-facts fixture from CIK0001045810, retrieved November 1, 2026, and retained for verification November 2. It covers FY2024–FY2026 and associated eligible facts. The broader productive-assets tag is mapped to a separately labeled equipment/intangible-purchases field only for NVIDIA. Its FY2026 $96.575B FCF is a reviewed company-published non-GAAP disclosure from the February 25, 2026 release, not the normalizer's FCF formula. See `src/disclosures.mjs` for the URL and definition.

The `audit/` directory contains 11 selected SEC company-facts/metadata cases captured November 2, 2026: META, GOOGL, TSLA, WMT, COST, JNJ, CAT, KO, XOM, JPM and the unsupported IFRS boundary TSM. Raw US GAAP units retain selected mapping tags and histories ending from 2021 onward with filing dates through the fixture date. Metadata is limited to issuer CIK and SEC industry classification. These support exact-period, provenance, calculation and gap regressions; only the original-filing spot checks described in `docs/COVERAGE_AUDIT.md` were manually performed. Run `npm run audit` to regenerate the source-linked selected-field inventory.
